title: Exponential time is not polynomial circuit size
statement: If $\mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP}$, then there is a language in exponential time that cannot be decided by any family of Boolean circuits of polynomial size.
hypotheses_covered: The class of polynomial-time languages equals the class of nondeterministic polynomial-time languages
